property_summary: After sending a call to owned() as a non-owner, the owner state variable must remain unchanged.
After a call to owned() by any address, the owner state variable must retain its previous value.
After a call to owned() by a non-owner, the caller address must not become the owner.
After any call to owned(), the owner state variable must remain unchanged.
After calling owned(), the owner state variable should be unchanged for any initial owner and caller.
After calling owned(), the owner state variable should remain unchanged for any initial owner and caller.
After calling owned() from any caller, the owner remains unchanged.
The owner does not change after a successful transferOwnership call (i.e., when called by the current owner).
After calling owned(), the value of transferOwnership() should equal the owner originally set
